about: XChaCha20-Poly1305 edge lengths (design.md:388) and one sealLocalV2 case (design.md:234), generated by scripts/gen-vectors-v2.mjs. ciphertext_with_tag_hex is the ciphertext followed by the 16-byte tag. The subkey and 12-byte nonce follow draft-irtf-cfrg-xchacha-03 §2.3.

parameters.pairing: every plaintext length up to 65 with every AAD length; 16,500 with AAD length 17
parameters.labels: secret(label) = SHA-256(UTF-8(prefix || label)); a draw of n <= 32 bytes is the first n bytes of secret(label); longer data is secret(label + "/0") || secret(label + "/1") || ... cut to length

seal_local_v2.what: sealLocalV2(key, aad, plaintext) with one 24-byte nonce draw; the AAD is the host's CBOR ["moretag/self/v1", device_id]
